# Opcode Catalog

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_opcode_docs.py from protocol/opcodes.json. -->

Opcodes are written in wire order. The little-endian value is how a `uint16`
reader represents the same two bytes. Treat observed frequency as structural
evidence, not as proof of packet meaning.

## Capture snapshot

The local C2S snapshot combines **2** independently keyed
world sessions, **155,393** decrypted frames, and
**1,743,144** RC4 body bytes. It contains
**144,307** confirmed `01 36` time packets.
Snapshot date: `2026-10-09`; client revisions:
`3526`, `3527`.

## Confirmed and partial field layouts

### `00 36` — `SERVER_TICK`

Regular server timestamp packet.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u64le` | `unix_ms` | confirmed |

### `00 37` — `CLIENT_MOVEMENT_UPDATE_VARIANT`

Shares the same position, packed-state, and timestamp layout as 01 37, but occurs much less often and commonly follows movement-skill sequences.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u8` | `movement_flags` | observed; 0x02 in retained samples |
| 3 | `f32le[3]` | `position_xyz` | confirmed |
| 15 | `bytes[7]` | `packed_movement_state` | unknown |
| 22 | `u64le` | `client_unix_ms` | confirmed |

### `00 38` — `CLIENT_SKILL_REQUEST`

All 16 distinct u32 values at offset 4 across 323 retained samples match published skill IDs. The request flags select a fixed 17-byte aim block, an optional one-byte marker, and zero, one, or two trailing float parameters.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u8` | `request_flags` | observed |
| 3 | `u8` | `request_stage` | observed; 0x01 in retained samples |
| 4 | `u32le` | `skill_id` | confirmed |
| 8 | `u8` | `entity_id_tag` | observed; 0x02 in retained samples |
| 9 | `uvarint` | `target_entity_id` | inferred |
| after target_entity_id | `f32le` | `aim_heading_degrees` | inferred |
| after aim_heading_degrees | `f32le[3]` | `target_or_aim_xyz` | inferred |
| after target_or_aim_xyz | `u8` | `action_mode` | observed |
| if request_flags & 0x04 | `u8` | `optional_marker` | observed; 0x01 in retained samples |
| if request_flags & 0xA0 | `uvarint` | `optional_parameter_id` | unknown |
| after optional_parameter_id | `f32le[1 or 2]` | `optional_parameter_values` | shape confirmed; semantics unknown |
| body_end-8 | `u64le` | `client_unix_ms` | confirmed |

### `01 36` — `CLIENT_TIME`

A newly sampled client timestamp, not an exact echo of the preceding server tick.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u64le` | `unix_ms` | confirmed |

### `01 37` — `CLIENT_MOVEMENT_UPDATE`

High-frequency movement update. Retained samples carry finite world coordinates and a client timestamp, commonly at roughly 10 Hz while moving.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u8` | `movement_flags` | observed; 0x02 in retained samples |
| 3 | `f32le[3]` | `position_xyz` | confirmed |
| 15 | `bytes[7]` | `packed_movement_state` | unknown |
| 22 | `u64le` | `client_unix_ms` | confirmed |

### `0E 37` — `CLIENT_DODGE_REQUEST`

Every retained packet carries skill 15000100 or its 15000101 variant; 15000100 is independently catalogued as Dodge. These packets begin a repeated 0E 37 -> 0F 37 -> 0F 37 movement sequence.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u8` | `request_flags` | observed; 0x19 in retained samples |
| 3 | `u32le` | `skill_id` | confirmed |
| 7 | `u8` | `request_stage` | observed; 0x01 in retained samples |
| 8 | `f32le[3]` | `position_xyz` | confirmed |
| 20 | `f32le[3]` | `direction_xyz` | inferred |
| 32 | `f32le` | `heading_degrees` | inferred |
| 36 | `u32le` | `target_entity_id` | inferred |
| 40 | `f32le[3]` | `movement_vector_scaled` | inferred |
| 52 | `u8` | `movement_mode` | observed; 0x01 in retained samples |
| 53 | `u64le` | `client_unix_ms` | confirmed |

### `0F 37` — `CLIENT_DODGE_MOVEMENT`

Movement samples following 0E 37 Dodge requests. The 40-byte form has an additional movement-mode byte immediately before the timestamp.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |

| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u8` | `movement_flags` | observed |
| 3 | `f32le[3]` | `position_xyz` | confirmed |

| body_end-8 | `u64le` | `client_unix_ms` | confirmed |

### `10 36` — `CLIENT_RSA_HANDSHAKE`

Clear packet that installs an ephemeral RSA-2048 public key with exponent 3.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `uvarint` | `rsa_der_length` | confirmed |
| 2+uvarint_width | `bytes[rsa_der_length]` | `rsa_public_key_pkcs1_der` | confirmed |
| after rsa_public_key | `u32le` | `client_revision` | confirmed |
| after client_revision | `bytes[4]` | `constant_04060502` | confirmed |
| after constant | `ascii[2]` | `region` | confirmed |
| body_end-1 | `u8` | `trailing_02` | confirmed |

### `10 56` — `CLIENT_STARTUP_SIGNAL`

Opcode-only packet observed in both initial encrypted sequences; semantics are open.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |

### `11 36` — `SERVER_RSA_HANDSHAKE`

The 256-byte block decrypts as RSA-OAEP-SHA1 and yields the complete 214-byte RC4 key.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u16le` | `status` | confirmed |
| 4 | `u32le` | `timeout_ms` | confirmed |
| 8 | `uvarint` | `rsa_ciphertext_length` | confirmed |
| 10 | `bytes[256]` | `rsa_ciphertext` | confirmed |
| 266 | `u64le` | `reserved` | confirmed |
| 274 | `i32le` | `sentinel_or_result` | confirmed |

### `13 36` — `CLIENT_SESSION_SETUP`

First encrypted body in both sessions. It contains printable identification and encoded session fields; raw values are excluded.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `bytes[156]` | `session_setup_payload` | unknown |

### `18 37` — `CLIENT_ACTION_POSITION`

Position and heading snapshot that frequently appears immediately before 00 38 skill requests.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |
| 2 | `u16le` | `action_flags` | observed; zero in retained samples |
| 4 | `f32le[3]` | `position_xyz` | confirmed |
| 16 | `f32le` | `heading_degrees` | inferred |
| 20 | `u64le` | `client_unix_ms` | confirmed |

### `40 8D` — `CLIENT_ZLIB_BLOB`

Carries a zlib stream that expands to UTF-16LE JSON-like configuration content.

| Offset | Type | Field | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `bytes[2]` | `opcode` | confirmed |

## Confidence levels

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `locally-confirmed` | Reproduced locally across independent sessions or verified byte-for-byte against runtime code. |
| `publicly-confirmed` | Implemented by at least two independent public parsers. |
| `parser-based` | Present in a public parser but not yet validated field-by-field locally. |
| `inferred` | Strong structural evidence exists, but the application meaning still needs a controlled test. |
| `observed` | The opcode and shape are reproducibly visible after decryption; semantics are open. |
| `hypothesis` | A candidate interpretation that requires another experiment. |

## Updating the registry

Edit `protocol/opcodes.json`, then regenerate and validate:

```powershell
python tools/generate_opcode_docs.py --write
python tools/generate_opcode_docs.py --check
```

Raw payloads, session identifiers, and capture-specific secrets must remain
in ignored local artifacts.
